query: 2026 primary election dates Florida Arizona Wisconsin governor primary August 2026
answer:
I've completed the research on 2026 gubernatorial primary dates for the three states.

**Key finding:** The premise that all three primaries are in "August 2026" is only accurate for **Florida** and **Wisconsin**. **Arizona moved its primary to July 2026.**

| State | 2026 Gov. Primary | General |
|-------|-------------------|---------|
| **Florida** | August 18, 2026 | Nov 3, 2026 |
| **Arizona** | **July 21, 2026** (moved out of August) | Nov 3, 2026 |
| **Wisconsin** | August 11, 2026 | Nov 3, 2026 |

The most important caveat: On February 6, 2026, Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs signed a bipartisan bill permanently moving the state's primary from the first Tuesday in August to the second-to-last Tuesday in July, setting the 2026 date at **July 21, 2026**. Some secondary aggregator sites still show an outdated "August 4" date, but county election offices and Wikipedia confirm the July date. As of today (July 25, 2026), Arizona's primary has already occurred — Hobbs won unopposed and Biggs won the GOP primary with 73.6%.

Florida (August 18) and Wisconsin (August 11) both remain August primaries and are cross-validated across multiple authoritative sources.

key_facts: Florida 2026 gubernatorial primary: Tuesday, August 18, 2026 (general election Nov 3, 2026).
Wisconsin 2026 partisan/gubernatorial primary: Tuesday, August 11, 2026 (general election Nov 3, 2026).
Arizona 2026 gubernatorial primary: Tuesday, July 21, 2026 — NOT August.
Arizona moved its primary date on Feb 6, 2026 when Gov. Katie Hobbs signed a bipartisan bill permanently moving primaries to the second-to-last Tuesday in July (previously first Tuesday in August).
All three states share a general election date of November 3, 2026.
Florida: incumbent Ron DeSantis is term-limited and ineligible for a third consecutive term.
Wisconsin: incumbent Tony Evers declined to seek a third term (open seat, rated toss-up).
Arizona: Democratic incumbent Katie Hobbs secured her primary unopposed; Republican Andy Biggs won 73.6% over David Schweikert.
